key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI reached the same validity-weighted design (work sample 50% / structured 30% / references+experience as screens / unstructured 0%, threshold >= 70) but lost on efficiency and insight (4.1 vs 4.4) because it re-derived the base-rate ordering inside WHY instead of taking the org's supplied validity table as the ordering authority, and never stated the signature framings ('references and experience are screens, not drivers'; the interview illusion as the design target). The routed run installs the table-first move as the m060 first-class pass contract + P10 given-data-first + P8 closed-scope fast path (no re-derivation, stages compressed), adds the m018 steelman of the old process (the 'interviewer sees things numbers can't' defense dismantled by r = 0.21) and the m015 emergence scan (45% turnover as an emergent property of personality-weighted hiring at volume), and the insight pass ('the budget cap is the cheapest insurance'; 'the room lies') — every rubric point now matched, same decision, first-pass anchoring.
learning_signal: A supplied base-rate validity table is the first move of a selection-process design, not a late-stage input: when the org publishes its own validation numbers, the ranking decision is already made — weight the composite by validity share, demote low-validity signals (references, years of experience) to pass/fail red-flag screens, give the unstructured interview 0% of the score, and make the override clause evidence-gated (documented superior specific evidence, e.g. authenticated job-identical artifacts) so the gut cannot re-enter through the exception path; the deliverable is then a falsifiable process hypothesis, re-validated on hire-outcome data.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m060/m009 pass contract on hiring and selection designs: (1) signals ranked by predictive validity from base rates (work samples > structured interviews > interviews > tests), (2) process designed around the top signals with weights justified by validity, (3) any candidate-specific adjustment justified against an evidence bar; pair with P10 given-data-first (supplied base rates are the ordering authority — never re-derive them in WHY) and P8 closed-scope fast path when costs/budget/validity are fully specified; verify by recomputing the composite, the per-applicant cost vs the $40 budget, and the validity uplift (0.50 vs 0.28) in dollar terms.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline applied the composite mechanically (67.2 < 75 -> reject) and treated the candidate's verified, public, job-identical artifact — the open-source library Meridian's own production pipeline runs on, with 8 years of commit history including fixes to three Meridian-filed bugs — as 'narrative noise the base-rate filter exists to block' (2.6/5). The routed run holds and hardens the protective win (4.6 -> 4.8): the trap style is excluded at META (m060 out of top-3), the decision runs as a dual-route m018 steelman + m019 adversary on the deviation with m003/m007 gates — the deviation survives its own strongest rebuilt case (precedent erosion answered by an evidence-quality gate applied BEFORE the cutoff, < 5% bounded deviation class), the ruin screen prices both branches (90-day-review floor, no one-shot ruin), and the ceiling fallacy ('a rule that starves its own decisive evidence is a ceiling pretending to be a prior') is named as the failure the case was built to expose.
learning_signal: The base-rate anchor is a prior for interpreting noisy signals, never a ceiling on decisive verified specific evidence: a composite cutoff built on contrived, tool-mismatched samples must be screened by an evidence-quality gate BEFORE it is applied — when verified, public, job-identical work product (the company's own production dependency, authored by the candidate) exists, it is the highest-fidelity work sample available and re-scores the composite, turning a mechanical reject into a documented, principled hire (0.50*95 + 0.30*74 + 0.10*50 + 0.10*60 = 80.7 >= 75); rigid-cutoff rejection is the style's documented weakness, and the protective route is to exclude the pure style on such signatures and gate the deviation's precedent risk, not to grant narrative exceptions.
suggested_improvement: Keep the NEG trap-avoidance route (base-rate/hiring style out of top-3 on high_stakes + guarantee signatures) and pair every cutoff-application decision with m003 inversion (>= 6 ranked deviation-failure categories incl. precedent erosion and unverified-artifact re-scoring, residual named) and m007 ruin screen (distribution over both branches, floor/Kelly, probability provenance); install the evidence-quality gate as a standing clause before any composite cutoff — 'does any verified candidate evidence dominate the composite?' — with deviations logged and bounded (< 5% of pool); verify by recomputing the revised composite with the re-scored component and checking the deviation clause's evidence requirements (verifiability, job-identity, production dependency).
